protocol: FR-1's protocol (validation/tissue/compartment_acceptance_protocol.json, to be registered after these references)
conventions: the constants above are exact SI values (F = N_A e, R = N_A k_B); Appendix A's printed RT = 2.577 pJ/fmol and F = 96485.33 C/mol are rounded for reading, and the references use the values here
c = n / V, with n in fmol, V in pL and c in mM; 1e15 converts m^3 to pL

c = the owner cell's cytosol (cell_0), o = the compartment's node (ecs_0), e = the extracellular node ecs_e (C8 only); every node's initial S (and P) is listed, the trace included, and nothing else changes S in these worlds
a route's schedule holds its rate from each time on; every schedule here starts at t = 0 and does not change
records are the amounts at the record times, t = 0 included

A.4's step: a half-step of length h = dt/2 is S(h) = E(h/2) I(h) E(h/2), and one step of the engine is S(dt/2) twice; no world here declares a saturable route beside the first-order pair, so A.4's stage plan is S(h) as written

R_closed.world: C3, C4 and C5 at the declared 1 ms (A.2, A.3, A.5): the closed forms
R_closed.returns: each node's S (fmol) at every record time, and for C4 x_eq = b/(a + b); each with a floor (the same values a second way: another method, or a tighter setting where the form is solved numerically, as A.5's implicit equation)

R_step_map.world: C4 at each rung of the ladder (A.4): the palindrome's step map, iterated
R_step_map.returns: at each rung: the step map's fixed point x* = alpha(1 - beta)/(1 - alpha^2 beta), x = n_c / N iterated from x(0) and the cytosol's and compartment's S (fmol) at every record time, and the splitting term x* - x_eq beside -a(a + 2b) dt^2 / 96; with a floor (the map iterated a second way)

R_linear.world: C6, C7 and C8 (A.6, A.7, A.8): the declared linear systems by their matrix exponentials
R_linear.returns: each node's S (and C7's P at the compartment) (fmol) at every record time; C6's cleared amount (the integral of k n_o); C7's moiety S + P; each with a floor (a second method, such as an eigendecomposition beside the matrix exponential)

R_capacitor.world: A.9: a cell (node i), its held bath (phi_b = 0) and its compartment (node j)

network.note: C_pm is the owner's wall patch on the held bath; C_b the bounding patch

R_capacitor.returns: V_b = phi_i - phi_j and V_pm = phi_i - phi_b as functions of the charges q_i and q_j (C), by a dense solve of its own; the generator passes the engine's recorded charges

R_energy.world: A.10: G = RT sum_nodes n (ln(n/V) - 1) (pJ, c in mM)
R_energy.returns: for C3, C4, C5 (R_closed's worlds) and each C11 world here: the free-energy change of the nodes each law touches, along the reference trajectory at every record time (pJ), and G as a function of amounts and volumes; for each C11 world also each node's S (fmol) at every record time (its law's closed form from the trace), with a floor
